name: agenciageo.mx
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: agenciageo.mx scores 89 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 13 are at risk, and 35 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 45 elements on /, /geo/, /metodologia/metodo-cita/, for example .services-link[href$="agencia-geo/"] and .services-link[href$="servicios/"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /geo/, /metodologia/metodo-cita/, for example a[aria-label="Agencia GEO - Inicio"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: 9 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /geo/ (69), /casos-de-exito/ (72), /blog/ (69), /jesus-ramirez/ (70) and 5 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: No sitemap was found
fix.evidence: robots.txt names https://agenciageo.mx/sitemap.xml but it did not return URLs.
fix.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.
